tools.name: get_daily_brief
tools.description: List the stories in OIYO's Korean daily tech/AI/market brief for one date (YYYY-MM-DD, KST). Omit date for the latest edition. Returns titles, one-line Korean summaries, source domains and links to the OIYO brief.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search recent OIYO news briefs by keyword (Korean or English; Korean initial consonants like ㅅㅅㅈㅈ also work). Every word must match. Title matches rank first, then newer dates.

tools.name: get_econ_wire
tools.description: Near-realtime economy/market headlines (refreshed about every minute) from public RSS of Korean and US publishers and central banks (Yonhap, Hankyung, Maeil, Bank of Korea, MOEF, Federal Reserve, SEC, CNBC, CoinDesk).
